description: Send a report to the Fencer Intel team: an entry with wrong data (severity, affected or fixed versions, packages, KEV, EPSS), a vulnerability or fix the feed is missing, or a tool that returned something wrong. Use it only when the user asks to report something, or agrees to a report you propose. Say what you saw, where (the entry id, or the tool and the arguments you passed), what you expected, and a source link when you have one. Never include secrets, credentials, lockfile contents or personal data: people read every report, and it is kept for 365 days. If the call returns an error, the report was not saved. Nobody replies, so it is not a way to ask a question. At most 5 reports per 60 seconds.

id.description: The CVE, GHSA or OSV id the report is about, if any.

kind.description: wrong_data: an entry says something wrong. missing_entry: a vulnerability the feed lacks. missing_fix: a fixed version the feed lacks. tool_problem: a tool failed or answered wrongly. other: anything else.

message.description: What is wrong or missing, what you expected, and a source link when you have one.

tool.description: The tool the report is about, if any.

name: report_feedback
title: Report feedback
